info.title: Glaass Pro
info.description: Enables users to interact with forms (Cases) filled out in Glaass and extract data from Case fields. Triggers include Case creation and Case updates, allowing users to set up custom workflows for templates in Glaass projects whenever changes occur, whether for actioning or recording purposes. Useful for custom workflow automations, data integration, supporting construction-related notifications, and enhancing operational efficiency in the field and office.
